integrity: Original motivating definitions and known one-step approximation theorems are credited to the cited authors; the new assertion concerns iterated absorption and the two finite-degree exponential bounds.
scientific_limitations: The finite-degree exponential envelopes are not asserted optimal; no extension beyond positive logarithmic Bernstein kernels or higher dimensions. Some earlier iteration literature has incomplete open full-text access. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: Two-sided exponential fixation envelopes for iterated logarithmic Bernstein operators
